entries.name: Tinker: Teleport
entries.makes:
Augment your belt to give the following effect:

Teleport forward 20 yds.

This enhancement is permanent and cannot be removed or replaced.

entries.name: Tinker: Nitro Boosts
entries.makes:
Augment your belt to give the following effect:

Activate a set of jets to increase your movement speed by up to 160%, for up to 8 sec.

This enhancement is permanent and cannot be removed or replaced.

entries.name: Tinker: Magnetic Displacement
entries.makes:
Augment your belt to give the following effect:

Disrupt a magnetic field between you and your nearby enemy target, knocking you both away.

Can only affect targets up to 2 levels higher than you. Some targets cannot be displaced. Targets can only be affected by this effect once every 2 min.

This enhancement is permanent and cannot be removed or replaced.
